features.name: log_amount
features.definition: Natural log of (transaction amount + 1) via np.log1p; compresses the heavy-tailed amount distribution for scale-sensitive models.

features.name: hour_of_day
features.definition: Local calendar hour of the transaction timestamp (0-23).

features.name: day_of_week
features.definition: ISO weekday of the transaction timestamp (Monday=0 ... Sunday=6).

features.name: is_weekend
features.definition: 1 when the transaction falls on Saturday or Sunday, else 0.

features.name: hour_sin
features.definition: Cyclical sine encoding of hour_of_day (period 24) so 23:00 and 00:00 are close in feature space.

features.name: hour_cos
features.definition: Cyclical cosine encoding of hour_of_day (period 24); paired with hour_sin to make the daily cycle unambiguous.

features.name: dow_sin
features.definition: Cyclical sine encoding of day_of_week (period 7).

features.name: dow_cos
features.definition: Cyclical cosine encoding of day_of_week (period 7); paired with dow_sin.

features.name: tx_count_1h
features.definition: Count of the sender's prior transactions in the trailing 1 hour (strictly prior events only; causal).

features.name: tx_count_24h
features.definition: Count of the sender's prior transactions in the trailing 24 hours (strictly prior events only; causal).

features.name: tx_amount_sum_24h
features.definition: Sum of the sender's prior transaction amounts in the trailing 24 hours (0 when no prior history).
derived_from: packages/features/temporal.py: sum(e[1] for e in events_24h)

features.name: amount_ratio_24h
features.definition: Current amount divided by the sender's mean prior 24h amount (floored denominator of 1.0; 1.0 when no prior history). Values > 1 mean the current transaction is larger than the sender's recent average.

features.name: time_since_prev_sec
features.definition: Seconds since the sender's previous transaction (default 86400.0 when this is the first observed transaction).

features.name: log_time_since_prev
features.definition: Natural log of (time_since_prev_sec + 1) via np.log1p; compresses the inter-arrival time scale.

features.name: distinct_devices_24h
features.definition: Distinct non-missing device identifiers used by the sender in the trailing 24 hours, including the current device (1 when no prior history).

features.name: distinct_ips_24h
features.definition: Distinct non-missing IP addresses used by the sender in the trailing 24 hours, including the current IP (1 when no prior history).

features.name: distinct_receivers_24h
features.definition: Distinct receivers paid by the sender in the trailing 24 hours, including the current receiver (1 when no prior history).

features.name: is_velocity_surge
features.definition: 1 when the sender shows a velocity surge: at least 3 prior transactions in the last hour OR at least 2 distinct devices in 24 hours; else 0.
